limitations: Applies only to ternary valuations for the (3,2)-Raney family. Gives valuation counts, not residues modulo higher powers, and fixed-r rather than uniform growing-r asymptotics. Earlier pointwise valuations and valuation-zero counts are explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof includes all-index arguments and separate reproducible finite checks; numerical checks are not represented as proofs. Priority risk of unindexed equivalent distribution formulas remains. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Complete ternary valuation spectra for the \((3,2)\)-Raney numbers
